## Reviewer checklist (human)
- [ ] I read every changed file, not just the summary
- [ ] I can explain what every changed line does
- [ ] The tests check the behavior from the issue, and none were weakened or deleted to make them pass
- [ ] I ran it locally (`npm run dev`) and it works
- [ ] No new dependencies, secrets, or files I did not expect
- [ ] This PR only does what its issue asked for
- [ ] I thought about "what could break?" and I am OK with the answer
